value.rationale: Dependence between empirical state occupancies is a mathematically motivated quantity because the original process exhibits nonvanishing fluctuations and fails an a.s. occupation limit. The exact positive/negative covariance transition and its large-d sqrt(d log d) scale identify a structural reversal invisible to the established marginal means and excursion times.
